jobs.prompt:
Create a PRODUCTION GAME CHARACTER SPRITE SHEET, not a UI mockup. Use the character in the supplied reference design sheet as the identity and soft matte 3D rendering reference. The official reference is supplementary for distinctive features. Extract and recreate ONLY that single character. Output ONE PNG with genuinely transparent alpha background, no white background and no fake checkerboard. Wide landscape sheet, three equally spaced full-body poses arranged in ONE horizontal row, one mascot in each third. All three poses SAME size, SAME front three-quarter camera, SAME feet baseline and consistent identity/lighting/materials. Plenty of transparent separation between columns, 8% padding, no overlap. Each whole character fully visible including ears, head decoration and feet. Left pose: calm friendly small smile, both arms relaxed. Middle pose: mild concerned expression, small worried mouth and lowered eyebrows, one hand near cheek, tasteful not distressed. Right pose: happy smile and one hand/wing waving. Keep body dimensions and clothing/accessory unchanged between poses. NO pedestal/base, no ground plane, no UI, no tiles, no text, no captions, no letters, no numbers, no shadow outside character silhouette, no icons, no extra objects, no money, no other characters. Soft polished matte toy depth, clean silhouette and clear readable eyes for use at 32-120px. Do not include other parts of the reference mockup. Target landscape 3:1 aspect ratio. Critical: alpha transparency; one row of three separate unclipped poses.
Character: Lime green Ollie baby dinosaur, white single head bump, cream oval belly, olive nose, large friendly eyes. No clothes.
